messages:
partner-onboarding: Heads-up — kickoff with ZephyrAI (open weights) this morning. Key ask: allow a download-only 'quantized' SKU in cloud marketplaces + a co-managed SI hosting option. Need legal + eng + SI + marketing alignment. Notes below.
kenji: Clarify 'download-only' — do they mean customers can download quantized weights from the marketplace and self-host? That has redistribution implications.
elaine: They proposed a dual-license model: permissive research license (MIT) for non-commercial research, and a separate commercial addendum that restricts redistribution outside approved channels. Legal already flagged export control & embargo risks.
maria: From runtime: 4-bit / 3-bit quant variants require custom kernels and packaging. If we let downloads out, we should provide a dockerized runtime shim that enforces telemetry + usage caps for marketplace SKUs. Also: prefix/KV cache behaviour differs with quant kernels — need validation tests.
samir: SI perspective — we can offer a co-managed instance but Zephyr wants telemetry (usage + perf) aggregated only, with an opt-out for enterprise customers. We need a status on what telemetry fields are mandatory.
legal-bot: High-level legal note: add a distribution addendum with two key points: (1) prohibition on rehosting to third-party public endpoints; (2) geoblocking clause matching US export lists. Draft snippet: 
```
Distributor shall not transfer model weights, checkpoints, or derivative artifacts to end-users located in countries embargoed under applicable export control laws. Distributor agrees to implement geoblocking and runlist checks prior to distribution. Any breach requires immediate notification to ZephyrAI and Redwood Inference.
```
jordan: Marketing asks: no public joint announcement until (a) marketplace listing is live, (b) SI runbook validated, and (c) legal addendum signed. Proposed embargo: 2 weeks after listing. Need logo usage SLA.
partner-onboarding: Action items I captured: 
- Legal (elaine) to draft commercial addendum + export clause (due Wed EOD)
- Runtime (maria, kenji) to prototype packaging + test quant kernels on Dedicated images (POC by next Tue)
- SI (samir) to produce SSO/runbook + telemetry field list (due Thu)
- Marketing (jordan) to draft announcement timeline + logo asset request (due Fri)
please reply if I missed anything.
kenji: Quick product question — if the marketplace distributes downloads, how do we handle meter/billing/rev-share? Zephyr requested a per-inference revenue share when we host; for downloads they want a percentage on marketplace sales. We should map marketplace SKU -> partner_sku label in our billing.
maria: We can attach metadata (partner_id, sku_type) to any Dedicated or Hosted deployment. For downloads, marketplace will handle transaction; our main concern is preventing incompatible runtime combos. Suggest we publish a validated 'redwood-quant-runtime' image that marketplace can reference.
elaine: Export controls team also requests provenance attestations from Zephyr about training data sources. They need a short attestation form filled before we sign.
samir: SI needs an onboarding checklist (SSO, KMS integration, backups, monitoring dashboards). I'll draft and post to the playbook folder and tag deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Created checklist: /playbooks/marketplace-onboard/zephyrai-checklist.md — includes SSO, KMS, telemetry, geoblock tests. Link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace-onboard/zephyrai-checklist.md
partner-onboarding: Next synchronous step: Fri 10:00am PT sync with Zephyr + legal + eng + SI. I'll confirm with partner. Emoji: :eyes:
jordan: Also request: co-marketing budget ask from Zephyr (paid ads + joint blog). I'll include in kickoff ask.
legal-bot: One more legal flag — we should include an indemnity carveout for misuse if Zephyr's license allows downstream modification. Recommend adding a 'no-derivative-public-hosting' clause.
partner-onboarding: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket and ping for the Fri invite.
